description: Create a new text or link post in a subreddit. Mutating and NOT idempotent — each call publishes a separate post. Requires REDDIT_USERNAME and REDDIT_PASSWORD; fails without them. Returns the new post's id and URL. Check get_subreddit_rules and get_post_flairs first, since many subreddits require a flair or reject certain content. WARNING: rapid posting or duplicate content may trigger Reddit's spam detection and account bans — enable REDDIT_SAFE_MODE=standard for rate limiting and duplicate detection.

content.description: For a self post (is_self=true): the body text, Reddit markdown supported. For a link post (is_self=false): the destination URL.

flair_id.description: Link flair template id from get_post_flairs; many subreddits require one or the post is auto-removed.

flair_text.description: Custom flair text, allowed only for flairs whose template is text-editable.

is_self.description: true = text/self post using `content` as the body (default); false = link post using `content` as the URL.

subreddit.description: Target subreddit, without the r/ prefix (e.g. 'test').

title.description: Post title (cannot be edited after creation).

name: create_post
